README: CLI quick start, MCP registration, Live confirm flow
`account summary [--mode]` (equity, cash, buying power, day P&L) for sandbox/paper/live
`account buying-power` and `account pdt` (day-trade count, PDT flag)
`account activities [--since]` (fills, dividends, fees)
`account clock` and `account calendar` (market session in ET)
`positions list [--mode]` with unrealized P&L
`positions show <symbol>` incl. owning strategy and diary row
`positions reconcile` (broker vs strategy bookkeeping, read-only report)
`orders list [--status]` and `orders show <id>`
`orders cancel <id>` and `orders cancel-all [--symbol]` through the gateway
`orders history [--days]`
`trade buy|sell <symbol> <qty> [--limit] [--stop] [--target] [--mode]` through the gateway
`trade short|cover <symbol> <qty>` through the gateway
`trade flatten --symbol|--strategy|--all [--mode]`
`trade preview …` (dry run: every gate verdict, no order)
`trade confirm <code>` executes a pending Live intent
`trade pending` lists unexpired Live confirmations
`trade notional <symbol> <$>` (fractional/notional buy) through the gateway

`account config [--mode]` show and `account config set <key> <value>` (PATCH /v2/account/configurations: dtbp_check, pdt_check, no_shorting, fractional_trading, max_margin_multiplier, max_options_trading_level, trade_confirm_email, suspend_trade, ptp_no_exception_entry); Live set needs a confirmation code

`account history [--period 1D|1W|1M|3M|1A|all] [--timeframe] [--extended] [--mode]` portfolio history (GET /v2/account/portfolio/history) with a Braille equity chart and true day P&L (profit_loss, excludes deposits)

`orders place` full Alpaca order surface through TransactionGateway: market/limit/stop/stop_limit/trailing_stop (trail_percent|trail_price), TIF day/gtc/opg/cls/ioc/fok, extended_hours, notional and fractional qty, client_order_id, position_intent
`orders bracket|oco|oto` order classes (take_profit, stop_loss with limit) through TransactionGateway
`orders replace <id> [--qty] [--limit] [--stop] [--trail] [--tif]` (PATCH /v2/orders/{id}) through TransactionGateway
`positions close <symbol> [--qty|--percentage] [--mode]` (DELETE /v2/positions/{symbol}) as an exit through TransactionGateway
`positions close-all [--cancel-orders] [--mode]` (DELETE /v2/positions) through TransactionGateway; Live needs a confirmation code
`options spread` multi-leg (order_class mleg, up to 4 legs, ratio_qty, position_intent) through TransactionGateway

`assets list [--class us_equity|us_option|crypto] [--exchange] [--status] [--attributes]` and `assets show <symbol>` (tradable, shortable, easy_to_borrow, marginable, fractionable, maintenance margin)
`watchlists list|show|create|rename|add|remove|delete` Alpaca server-side watchlists (/v2/watchlists by id and by name)
`crypto buy|sell <pair> <qty|--notional>` crypto orders (BTC/USD etc, gtc/ioc, fractional) through TransactionGateway; `crypto positions`
`crypto wallets|transfers|whitelist|fee-estimate` crypto funding (/v2/wallets...) read ops; any withdrawal/transfer is a money movement behind a confirmation code even on paper
Hub streaming: server-sent events from the Hub (`/api/stream`) so long-running ops can push lines; CLI renders them live, MCP returns a bounded window

`alpaca raw <GET|POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE> <path> [--body json] [--data] [--mode]` escape hatch for any Alpaca endpoint; refuses order/position/exercise/funding mutations (points to the gated ops) and Live mutations need a code
docs/ALPACA_COVERAGE.md: every Alpaca Trading + Market Data endpoint mapped to its idiotproof operation (or alpaca raw), with an NUnit test that fails when an inventoried endpoint has no operation
